import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long EXTREME_INF = 17446744073709551616L;
    static long M, nCount, kCount;
    static long[][] dpStates = new long[19][300005];
    static long[] factArr = new long[300005], invFactArr = new long[300005];

    static long fast_pow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1L;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1L) == 1L) res = (res * base) % M;
            base = (base * base) % M;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long nCr(int a, int b) {
        return (((factArr[a] * invFactArr[b]) % M) * invFactArr[a - b]) % M;
    }

    static long compute() {
        int i, j, mask;
        factArr[0] = 1L;
        long limit = Math.max(nCount, kCount);
        for (i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
            factArr[i] = (factArr[i - 1] * i) % M;
        }
        invFactArr[(int)limit] = fast_pow(factArr[(int)limit], M - 2);
        for (i = (int)limit - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFactArr[i] = (invFactArr[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % M;
        }
        for (i = 1; i <= nCount; i++) {
            dpStates[1][i] = invFactArr[i];
        }
        long totalRes = (dpStates[1][(int)nCount] * nCr((int)kCount, 1)) % M;
        int maxIter = (int)Math.min(18, kCount);
        for (i = 2; i <= maxIter; i++) {
            for (j = (int)nCount; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & (int)nCount) {
                if (dpStates[i - 1][j] == 0) continue;
                int rem = (int)nCount ^ j;
                for (mask = rem; mask > j; mask = (mask - 1) & rem) {
                    dpStates[i][j ^ mask] += dpStates[i - 1][j] * invFactArr[mask];
                    if (dpStates[i][j ^ mask] > EXTREME_INF) dpStates[i][j ^ mask] %= M;
                }
            }
            for (j = (int)nCount; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & (int)nCount) {
                if (dpStates[i][j] >= M) dpStates[i][j] %= M;
            }
            long resVal = (dpStates[i][(int)nCount] * nCr(i, (int)kCount)) % M;
            resVal = (resVal * factArr[i]) % M;
            totalRes = (totalRes + resVal) >= M ? totalRes + resVal - M : totalRes + resVal;
        }
        totalRes = (totalRes * factArr[(int)nCount]) % M;
        return totalRes;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        nCount = sc.nextLong();
        kCount = sc.nextLong();
        M = sc.nextLong();
        long ans = fast_pow(kCount, nCount);
        if (nCount % 2 == 0) ans = (ans - compute() + M) % M;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
